component.name: Euphony Music
component.summary: Modern, 100% ad-free, open-source Neo-Brutalist music player

description.p: Euphony Music is a modern, high-performance, open-source music player built with Flutter, Riverpod, and Drift SQLite for Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

ul.li: Zero Ads & Zero Tracking: Complete privacy with no user accounts, no subscriptions, and zero telemetry.
Material 3 & Neo-Brutalist UI: High-contrast slab borders, hard offset shadows, and expressive typography with Light, Dark, and pure AMOLED black modes.
Fast Local Caching: Powered by Drift SQLite for instantaneous library search and persistent playlists.
High Fidelity Audio: Playback support for MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, and OPUS local audio files.
Native Media Controls: Seamless background playback, lock screen controls, and notification panel media controls.

description.p: Euphony v1.0.1 with F-Droid compliance, SQLite vendor source build, and desktop shortcuts polish.
